title: About
intro: I have been a software engineer for 13 years and chose to stay an individual contributor. I build core systems; I don’t manage people.
path: I started in 2013 with Android games, moved to iOS apps, spent 2015 to 2020 in applied machine learning, and now build full-stack TypeScript products around language models. Kodama Labs is my one-person company and the name I ship under.
